job_hypothesis: Get overhead runs straight on the first pass without climbing down to check
name: Luis Ortega
behaviors: Commercial electrician mounting conduit and fixtures on ladders all day
Climbs down 4 or 5 times per run to check the bubble
Buys his own hand tools; the company buys the big ones
current_alternatives: A torpedo level read from the ladder at an awkward angle
Climbing down to sight the bubble from below
A helper on the ground calling out readings
A self-leveling cross-line laser, on jobs where the company has one
objections: Sites are loud; he may not hear a tone over saws and compressors
On jobs with a laser, the problem is already solved
Anything he carries up a ladder has to survive drops and a tool bag
He won't spend much of his own money on something he thinks the company should buy
